description: Printable ribbed L bracket with mounting holes
description_en: Printable ribbed L bracket with mounting holes
manufacturing_notes: Use ribs instead of very thick walls
Hole diameter should include screw clearance
Fillet rib roots to reduce stress concentration
failure_modes: Large fillets on ribs can fail
Unsupported horizontal arm may need chamfer or print orientation guidance
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# [Bracket]
# [Dimension]
base_length_mm = 80  # [40:1:160]
# [Dimension]
height_mm = 60  # [30:1:140]
# [Dimension]
width_mm = 28  # [16:1:60]
# [Dimension]
thickness_mm = 6  # [3:0.5:12]
# [Dimension]
hole_diameter_mm = 4.3  # [2.5:0.1:8]
# [Dimension]
rib_thickness_mm = 5  # [3:0.5:10]

base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(base_length_mm, width_mm, thickness_mm)
vertical = cq.Workplane("XY").box(thickness_mm, width_mm, height_mm).translate((-base_length_mm / 2 + thickness_mm / 2, 0, height_mm / 2))
rib = cq.Workplane("YZ").workplane(offset=-base_length_mm / 2 + thickness_mm).polyline([(0, thickness_mm / 2), (0, height_mm - thickness_mm), (height_mm - thickness_mm, thickness_mm / 2)]).close().extrude(rib_thickness_mm, both=True)
result = base.union(vertical).union(rib)
result = result.faces(">Z").workplane().pushPoints([(-base_length_mm * 0.25, 0), (base_length_mm * 0.25, 0)]).hole(hole_diameter_mm)
result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(1.5)
show_object(result)
